list_source.how_68_identified: Main text 'Contaminated evidence in clinical practice guidelines': 218 substantially impacted meta-analyses (both direction and P-value significance changed; n=218 in Results) from 68 systematic reviews, cited as references 23-90 (19 Cochrane, 49 non-Cochrane).

sampling.positives: Up to 40 non-retracted reviews from paper refs 23-90. First 15 are the 16 Oct 2026 sealed sample (high-signal then Cochrane/non-Cochrane mix). Remaining slots fill in paper-ref order. Carlisle 2006 Cochrane PONV (ref 45, 10.1002/14651858.cd004125.pub2) excluded because Crossref/OpenAlex mark the review itself retracted. Ref 82 had no DOI.
sampling.controls: 10 journal-year matched reviews frozen on 16 Oct 2026 for 10 of the 15 sampled positives. 30 more journal-year matches frozen 2026-10-16T22:33:00+00:00 for the 5 remaining sampled positives and the 25 extra frozen positives, using the same T19 rule (same OpenAlex source.id + year; not in the reconstructed OSF All-sheet exclusion set; is_retracted=false; no retracted work in the first 80 referenced_works). OSF osf.io/7eazq returned HTTP 503 scheduled maintenance at freeze time; All-sheet exclusion used T19's paper-ref 23-90 list plus already-frozen positives/controls (n=77 reconstructed), not a live re-download of the 805-DOI xlsx. n_pos=40, n_ctrl=40. Not relabelled; MoolTrace had not been run on the new 30 controls at freeze time.

control_check: Same OpenAlex primary_location.source.id and publication_year as a distorted review in the frozen positive set; OpenAlex type=review when that filter returned candidates (documented replacements otherwise); DOI not in the VITALITY OSF All-sheet exclusion set; OpenAlex is_retracted=false on the review; none of the first 80 OpenAlex referenced_works had is_retracted=true. T19 replacements stand: PRISMA 2020 -> JCE 2021 LBP SR (10.1016/j.jclinepi.2021.05.020); CD007768.pub3 (634 refs) -> CD011231 (20 refs). T22 replacement: JAMA 2013 had no OpenAlex type=review works, so Petersen 2013 literature review 10.1001/jama.2013.8042 replaced a correction notice. OpenAlex is_retracted can miss notices; the OSF All-sheet exclusion is the primary check that the control did not include one of the 1330 VITALITY retracted RCTs. At T22 freeze, OSF returned 503 maintenance; the exclusion set was reconstructed from T19 paper refs 23-90 plus frozen positives/controls. New controls frozen_at 2026-10-16T22:33:00+00:00. First author was not emailed. Not relabelled after seeing MoolTrace verdicts (new rows were frozen before those runs).
